import time,datetime,json,sys
from dataclasses import dataclass,asdict
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Origin:
    wall: str
    clock: str
    tick_ns: int
origin=Origin(datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"python.time.perf_counter_ns / QueryPerformanceCounter",time.perf_counter_ns())
assert type(origin.tick_ns) is int and origin.tick_ns>=0
print(json.dumps({"event":"TASK_ACCEPTED","origin":asdict(origin),"clock_info":str(time.get_clock_info("perf_counter"))}),flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    command=json.loads(line)
    if command["action"]=="CHECK_FREEZE":
        context=asdict(origin)
        context.update(wall="changed",clock="changed",tick_ns=True)
        frozen_reject=False
        try:origin.tick_ns=0
        except Exception as exc:frozen_reject=type(exc).__name__=="FrozenInstanceError"
        print(json.dumps({"event":"FREEZE_CHECK","origin":asdict(origin),"context_mutated":context,"immutable_assignment_rejected":frozen_reject,"freeze_count":1}),flush=True)
    elif command["action"]=="SAMPLE":
        tick=time.perf_counter_ns()
        print(json.dumps({"event":command.get("label","SAMPLE"),"wall":datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"event_tick_ns":tick,"accepted_tick_ns":origin.tick_ns,"elapsed_ms":(tick-origin.tick_ns)/1000000,"strict_tick":type(tick) is int and tick>=0}),flush=True)
    elif command["action"]=="CLOSE":
        break
